exceptions.name: ch.qos.logback:logback-core
exceptions.reason: The advisory requires a compromised Logback configuration or injected configuration environment plus Janino and Spring. The candidate runtime image has Janino but no Spring and pins /opt/datax/datax/conf/logback.xml with no conditional processing. The Worker verifies the runtime-tree hash at startup; Compose uses a read-only Worker root filesystem and the image marks the runtime tree 0444/0555. Logback 1.3.16 fixes this advisory on JDK 8 but requires SLF4J 2 and still leaves three findings fixed only by Logback 1.5.25, 1.5.33, and 1.5.34. To avoid maintaining an incomplete transition, the planned migration moves once to JDK 11, SLF4J 2, and Logback 1.5.34.

exceptions.name: ch.qos.logback:logback-core
exceptions.reason: The SSRF path requires an attacker-modified Logback XML file containing a malicious DOCTYPE. The candidate runtime launches DataX with /opt/datax/datax/conf/logback.xml, which has no DOCTYPE. The Worker verifies the runtime-tree hash at startup; Compose uses a read-only Worker root filesystem and the image marks the runtime tree 0444/0555. Logback 1.3.15 fixes this advisory on JDK 8 but requires SLF4J 2 and the 1.3 line still leaves three findings fixed only by Logback 1.5.25, 1.5.33, and 1.5.34. The planned migration therefore moves once to JDK 11, SLF4J 2, and Logback 1.5.34.

exceptions.name: ch.qos.logback:logback-core
exceptions.reason: The vulnerable deserialization path is SimpleSocketServer or SimpleSSLSocketServer receiving attacker-controlled serialized data. The candidate runtime Logback configuration uses only ConsoleAppender and FileAppender, DataX starts no Logback socket server, and the Worker exposes no DataX listener. Logback 1.5.34 cannot replace this dependency until the current JDK 8 and SLF4J 1.x runtime architecture is migrated.

exceptions.name: ch.qos.logback:logback-core
exceptions.reason: The object-injection path is limited to serialized data accepted by SimpleSocketServer or SimpleSSLSocketServer. Neither server is configured or started; the candidate runtime configuration contains only local console and file appenders, and no DataX service port is exposed. The fixed Logback generation requires the planned JDK and SLF4J generation migration.

exceptions.name: ch.qos.logback:logback-core
exceptions.reason: The expression-language injection requires attacker control of Logback configuration and use of JaninoEventEvaluator. The candidate runtime configuration has no evaluator or conditional element and is selected by an explicit JVM argument. The Worker verifies the runtime-tree hash at startup; Compose uses a read-only Worker root filesystem and the image marks the runtime tree 0444/0555. Logback 1.3.15 fixes this advisory on JDK 8 but requires SLF4J 2 and the 1.3 line still leaves three findings fixed only by Logback 1.5.25, 1.5.33, and 1.5.34. The planned migration therefore moves once to JDK 11, SLF4J 2, and Logback 1.5.34.

exceptions.name: ch.qos.logback:logback-core
exceptions.reason: Class instantiation requires an attacker-compromised Logback configuration. The candidate runtime supplies one fixed configuration with only ConsoleAppender and FileAppender and selects it with an explicit JVM argument. The Worker verifies the runtime-tree hash at startup; Compose uses a read-only Worker root filesystem and the image marks the runtime tree 0444/0555. Replacement with the fixed Logback line is gated on the planned JDK and SLF4J generation migration.
